# Latrina Walden Exam Solutions

> > Comprehensive NP board exam prep courses and study materials for ANCC, AANP, and specialty certifications with practice questions, clinical reviews, and continuing education credits.

Latrina Walden Exam Solutions (LWES) is a specialized educational platform offering nurse practitioner certification exam preparation across multiple specialties including Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Adult-Gerontology Nurse Practitioner (AGNP), Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (ACNP), and Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP). The site features comprehensive study bundles, practice test banks, live webinars, and The Academy—a flagship 6-week intensive prep program led by Professor Walden.

## Key Topics

- Nurse Practitioner Certification
- ANCC Exam Prep
- AANP Exam Prep
- FNP (Family Nurse Practitioner)
- AGNP (Adult-Gerontology)
- ACNP (Acute Care)
- PMHNP (Psychiatric-Mental Health)
- Practice Questions & Test Banks
- Continuing Education Units (CEUs)
- Clinical Review Courses
- Pharmacology Study Materials
- Online Learning Platforms
- Latrina Walden (Professor Walden)
- The Academy Program
- Exam Review Strategies

## Core Exam Prep Programs

- [#1 NP Review Courses: ANCC/AANP Exam Prep - LWES](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com): LWES homepage: NP certification exam prep for ANCC/AANP specialties
- [The Academy](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/the-academy): 6-week comprehensive NP board exam prep program by Professor Walden
- [Nurse Practitioner Review Courses](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/pages/packages): NP review course packages for AANP/ANCC/AGNP certifications
- [ANCC & AANP Review Courses - NP Exam Specialties Test Bank](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/pages/np-exam-prep): NP specialty exam prep resources for ANCC/AANP certifications

## Specialty Certification Prep

- [AANP Certification Test Prep Review Course - LWES](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/aanp): AANP exam prep bundle with study guides and 45 CEUs
- [ANCC Certification Test Prep Review Course - LWES](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/ancc): ANCC exam prep bundle with pharmacology course and 70 CEUs
- [AGNP Certification Test Prep - LWES](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/agnp): AGNP exam prep bundle with crash course and 70 CEUs
- [ACNP Certification Review Courses | Adult-Gerontology Acute Care](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/acnp): ACNP exam prep with clinical cases and health policy materials
- [LWES PMHNP Review Courses - NP Exam Prep Certification](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/collections/pmhnp): PMHNP certification exam prep with online review courses

## Study Materials & Test Bundles

- [FNP Practice Question Test Bank Bundle](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/products/fnp-practice-question-test-bank-bundle): FNP test bank with 4000+ practice questions covering pathophysiology

- [Ultimate Acute Care Test Prep Bundle](https://shop.latrinawaldenexamsolutions.com/products/ultimate-acute-care-test-prep-bundle): Acute care certification exam prep focused on ACNP topics
